heading: OPENING / CLEAN-LINE DRAFT
footer: PRIVATE COMIC DRAFT / DESIGNS AND DIALOGUE PROVISIONAL

pages.title: A place to come back to
pages.purpose: An inhabited workplace, a coffee break, and an ordinary call from processing.

panels.action: Baikal at work, with Ebro and Kaveri berthed against Saturn.
Rina and Jonah share a coffee break in Baikal before Leila calls from processing.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Coffee's still hot. Take a minute before somebody finds you another job.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: I'll settle for half a minute.

dialogue.speaker: Leila / comms
dialogue.text: Jonah? Processing line's stopped. Can you come down?

pages.title: One line down
pages.purpose: A repair judgment, not a residential life-support crisis.

panels.action: Leila examines the isolated pump housing with her hands while Jonah listens beside the machinery.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Circulation pump's failed. We've isolated the line. The others are still running.

panels.action: Samir checks residential supplies at the processing console while Leila examines the isolated line.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Residential supply is normal.

panels.action: Leila explains why replacing the assembly is quicker than an overhaul.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah / off-panel
dialogue.text: Can you rebuild it here?

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Yes. But we'd lose more production waiting on the overhaul. A replacement gets us running sooner.

pages.title: A useful job
pages.purpose: The same pickup, delivery commitment, and borrowed-mug exchange, framed closer.

panels.action: Elena and Jonah arrange the Aquila pickup, with the waiting Ebro framed by the window.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: Aquila has a replacement assembly. Can Kaveri collect it?

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Yes. We can leave as soon as everyone's aboard.

panels.action: A delivery record connects Ebro and Foundation while Elena explains the commitment.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: EarthWorks is expecting Ebro's load aboard Foundation. We need that line back to have it ready on time.

panels.action: Elena closes the exchange with the borrowed-mug joke; Jonah answers from the foreground.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: And bring the mug back. We haven't budgeted for a replacement.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: I'll put it on the cargo list.

pages.title: Outbound
pages.purpose: A silent departure. Aquila is the next destination, not an arrival shown here.

panels.action: A Kaveri location card introduces the move aboard. Tomas reports readiness and Jonah gives the departure order.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: All aboard. Cargo space is clear, and the Aquila course is ready.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: All right. Take us out.

panels.action: Kaveri departs with its cradle empty and handling arm stowed. Baikal and Ebro recede. No attack or pursuit appears.

pages.title: Arrivals
pages.purpose: Arrive at a working freight town and show the crew sharing the pickup.

panels.action: Aquila from Kaveri's approach. Give the port useful scale and activity without adding a roster of identifiable background ships. Kaveri remains the camera's anchor. A location card says AQUILA / Saturn system / Later / Farspan's freight hub; "Later" is a draft stamp, not a fixed travel duration.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas / comms
dialogue.text: Aquila, Kaveri. Inbound for the Clearwell collection.

panels.action: In Aquila's pressurized, non-rotating transfer hall, Leila checks the assembly's connections in person. Rina controls its motion with the handling frame and restraints; Samir compares its identification with the order and delivery record. Handholds and tethered equipment establish freefall, not a standing warehouse. Jonah keeps the shared access clear, just outside this closer view. Both ships remain outside, visible through berth windows. Leila's closer check follows in 5c; she has travelled aboard Kaveri with them, not stayed at Baikal.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: This is ours?

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Matches the order. Leila?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Before I strap it down.

panels.action: Leila finishes checking the connection faces in person. Samir is beside her, ready to complete the receipt; Rina waits for her check before securing the load.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: That's the right one. Keep the protective covers on.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Even the awkward one?

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Especially the awkward one.

pages.title: Another crew's work
pages.purpose: Establish Nadia and Gantry as working colleagues, not doomed victims.

panels.action: Nadia and Rina share the pressurized transfer hall. Through its windows we see Gantry intact outside. Nadia waits while Rina guides Clearwell's restrained assembly toward the freight lock. Gantry's name is visible on its hull. Its unarmed workship design should be recognizable again at the rescue.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Gantry here. Are you finished with that space?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Nearly. It's awkward to turn.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: I'll keep our load clear.

panels.action: Jonah joins Nadia at the hall's handholds after the load clears their shared access. The freight lock has closed behind them, with the assembly restrained inside. Both doors are never open together. This is still a working exchange, not a meeting-room conversation.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Thanks for waiting.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Better than chasing both loads. Sen. Gantry.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Mercer. Kaveri.

panels.action: Rina signals that the assembly is secure for the freight-lock cycle. Nadia releases her handhold to return to her own job; the frontal likeness stays unchanged, and her reaching arm carries the movement. Both crews have somewhere to be. The sealed freight lock and exterior handling gear transfer the assembly to Kaveri's external cradle between this scene and 7a; no open doorway connects the pressurized hall to space.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Replacement?

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Baikal's lost a processing line.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Glad you found one.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: So are we. Safe trip.

pages.title: On the way home
pages.purpose: Close the ordinary pickup before the emergency interrupts it.

panels.action: Back inside Kaveri, Rina and Samir finish the restraint and access checks after the assembly has been clamped into the external cradle. The display confirms the load; they do not stand outside without suits. Through the window, Gantry leaves first, intact. No threatening shape watches it depart, and no departure interval is printed.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Load's secured. Passage is clear.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: And every cover is still on it.

panels.action: Kaveri outbound from Aquila, with the same covered assembly visible in its external cradle. A quiet, wider panel with the town falling behind. No dialogue. No promise that the next panel is only moments later.
Later in the return leg. Leila checks the load record near Jonah. The work is under control, and her attention can briefly return to home.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: I might make game night after all.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Is that good news for everyone else?

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: They can practice while I'm away.

pages.title: A familiar voice
pages.purpose: Replace the routine return with a specific, credible need.

panels.action: Samir at communications. A distress call interrupts the quiet. Jonah turns before Samir has finished identifying the sender.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia / comms
dialogue.text: Gantry, requesting assistance. Main propulsion disabled.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: That's the captain from Aquila.

panels.action: Jonah answers. Stay aboard Kaveri; no cutaway to the attack or Gantry's interior.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Gantry, Kaveri. We hear you. How many aboard?

dialogue.speaker: Nadia / comms
dialogue.text: Three. All alive. Owen's hurt. We've isolated the damaged spaces.

panels.action: Samir records the report while Tomas begins checking the relative tracks. Information comes from Nadia, not an omniscient map labelling every danger.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: What's still working?

dialogue.speaker: Nadia / comms
dialogue.text: Emergency power. Comms, attitude control, limited life support. They took the cargo and left us here.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Send your reserve estimate and the port status. We're checking an intercept.

pages.title: What it will cost
pages.purpose: Let each crewmember contribute to an informed decision.

panels.action: Tomas brings the revised route to Jonah. No invented numerical countdown is printed. The drawing distinguishes Kaveri's possible arrival from Gantry's expected endurance. Only the arrival ordering matters here, not a plotted orbit.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: We can reach them before their reserves run out. The scheduled recovery can't.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: And Baikal?

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: Later. Enough that we miss the repair plan. Ebro's load won't be ready.

panels.action: Rina and Leila assess the transfer route beside the secured assembly. The replacement stays aboard. Make the distinction between preserving cargo and clearing an assisted passage visible.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: We can bring three people through here. The assembly stays tied down.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: If their port is sound, we can dock. We don't need to restart their main bus.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Then let's get them off it.

panels.action: Tomas is not isolated as the scene's unkind person. Jonah takes the warning seriously before making a commitment on Clearwell's behalf.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: I want them out too. I want Elena to know what we're spending.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: She will. Keep working the intercept.

pages.title: The decision
pages.purpose: Refusal changes who pays, not whether preparation proceeds.

panels.action: Elena on Kaveri's comms display. Behind Jonah, Tomas continues the route work.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Three people. We can reach them. It will put the replacement in late.

dialogue.speaker: Elena / comms
dialogue.text: Understood. I'll ask EarthWorks to cover the diversion. Keep preparing.

panels.action: Aboard Kaveri, Samir monitors Elena's call with Daniel Reed at EarthWorks Operations. Clear speaker labels identify the two ends of the call. Keep the panel on that exchange, rather than crowding the other preparations behind him.

dialogue.speaker: Elena / comms
dialogue.text: Kaveri can reach your crew in time. Will EarthWorks cover the diversion?

dialogue.speaker: Daniel / comms
dialogue.text: No. We have a recovery scheduled.

dialogue.speaker: Elena / comms
dialogue.text: Your people won't last that long.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel / comms
dialogue.text: I'm not approving the cost.

panels.action: Elena speaks to Jonah again. He looks to Tomas, not toward an imaginary approval indicator. Leave room around the final instruction.

dialogue.speaker: Elena / comms
dialogue.text: Clearwell will cover it. Bring them home.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Tomas. Take the intercept.

pages.title: Across the gap
pages.purpose: Make the journey and the change of course tangible without a fight.

panels.action: A broad exterior: Kaveri on the new course, its replacement assembly still secured. The ship is small against the distance. Do not draw looping jet-fighter trails or a continuous burn simply to fill the panel. No dialogue.

Later, with Gantry now resolved ahead, Kaveri's crew compares the transmitted condition report with what they can see. The hull is stable, not tumbling. Damage interrupts the form we saw intact at Aquila.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: Gantry in sight. Matching their motion.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia / comms
dialogue.text: We can hold attitude. Main drive is out.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Understood. We come to you.

pages.title: One way in
pages.purpose: Give the stranded crew useful judgment in their own rescue.

panels.action: Leila studies the port area as Kaveri closes. Do not reveal hidden interior systems through an impossible scan. Her questions go to the people aboard.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Gantry, did the electrical fault reach the docking equipment?

dialogue.speaker: Owen / comms
dialogue.text: Not that branch. We isolated the main distribution. Leave it isolated.

panels.action: Rina prepares Kaveri's transfer side. Samir clears a receiving space and brings first-aid equipment. No equipment specification or permanent passenger layout is established by this staging.

dialogue.speaker: Leila / comms
dialogue.text: Agreed. We'll check the connection before anyone crosses.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo / comms
dialogue.text: The access is clear. Owen needs help moving.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Stay with him. We'll meet you at the opening.

panels.action: Jonah glances toward Samir rather than asking him to perform a miracle.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Ready for him?

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Ready to help him aboard. I'll need their account of the injury.

pages.title: Hold there
pages.purpose: Let controlled movement, not a surprise failure, carry the tension.

panels.action: Exterior close enough to understand the remaining gap. Gantry's damaged systems stay inactive. Kaveri approaches the verified port; keep both hull identities clear and do not add a second docking arrangement for this view.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas / comms
dialogue.text: Holding here for the port check.

dialogue.speaker: Leila / comms
dialogue.text: Give me the alignment view.

panels.action: Leila and Tomas concentrate on their different parts of the same operation. Neither explains basic flight controls to the competent captain.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: That's the port we checked. Approach is clear.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: Coming in.

panels.action: The ships connected, their bulk suddenly close. Both coast without thrust; the transfer spaces are in freefall. The moment is quiet rather than triumphant. Pressure and seal checks occur before the following page's opening; the particular transfer hardware remains a design decision.

dialogue.speaker: Leila / comms
dialogue.text: Connection secure. Checking the seal.

pages.title: Bring him through
pages.purpose: Rescue people through coordinated work, without an on-foot game promise.

panels.action: After the seal and pressure checks, Rina meets Ivo at the opened passage, using a handhold to stop herself. We enter Gantry's space only with Rina. Owen is alert but cannot move safely unaided. He is supported and secured for the freefall transfer; his exact injury and support equipment remain for staging review.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: I'm Rina. Tell me what he can manage.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: He's been helping with the checks. Moving is the problem.

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: I can tell you when to stop.

panels.action: Rina and Ivo guide Owen and his support through the passage, controlling his motion with handholds. They do not carry his weight under their arms. Give the secured body, their hands, and the clear route enough space to show how they start and stop together. Weightlessness does not remove his injury or inertia.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Good. We move together. Ready?

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: Ready.

panels.action: Samir receives Owen on Kaveri's side. Rina and Ivo keep his motion controlled until Samir has secured his support at the receiving position. Nobody lets go and expects him to stay put. The scene does not imply he needs no further care.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Owen, I'm Samir. Let's get you supported before we do anything else.

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: I'd like that.

pages.title: All three
pages.purpose: Finish the evacuation without inventing a hull destruction.

panels.action: From Kaveri's side of the passage, Jonah sees Nadia cross last. She brings the crew's working records, not a conveniently labelled conspiracy file.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: That's everyone. Three aboard Kaveri.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: All accounted for.

panels.action: Rina checks that the passage is clear. Leila prepares the separation. Owen stays with Samir; do not crowd everyone onto the flight deck for a group portrait.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Transfer side clear.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Closing and checking.

panels.action: Kaveri separates from Gantry. Hold enough space around the abandoned hull to let its loss of usefulness register. It does not explode. No pirates appear.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah / comms
dialogue.text: Baikal, Kaveri. We have all three. Coming home.

pages.title: The return
pages.purpose: Let the survivors react differently without instant political conversion.

panels.action: Later aboard Kaveri. Owen rests with support nearby. Ivo has learned of the funding refusal. Nadia asks Samir for the actual record rather than joining in an accusation she cannot yet support.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: They knew we were alive?

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.text: Elena sent them the estimate before the refusal.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Send me that exchange. I want an answer from Operations.

panels.action: Jonah pauses beside them during the return. A quiet acknowledgement, not a speech about what kind of person he is.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Thank you for coming.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: I'm glad we reached you.

pages.title: Back to work
pages.purpose: Deliver both the people and the intact part; the community can continue.

panels.action: Kaveri back at Baikal. Elena meets Jonah's crew and Gantry's people at arrival. Owen still receives assistance. Keep the welcome practical and relieved rather than staging a civic ceremony.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: Welcome to Baikal. Let's get you settled.

panels.action: Leila and Rina bring the replacement into processing. Return to the visual anchors of page 2: isolated line, surrounding plant still safely operating.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Every cover still on it.

dialogue.speaker: Leila
dialogue.text: Now we can take them off.

panels.action: Later, with the assembly installed and checks complete, the isolated line returns to service. This is a time cut, not an instant repair. Ebro is still waiting for the delayed load; restarting a pump does not create the missing production immediately.

dialogue.speaker: Leila / comms
dialogue.text: Line's back. We'll have the load, just not on the old schedule.

pages.title: The bill
pages.purpose: Put institutional unfairness beside a successful rescue, then end at home.

panels.action: Jonah and Elena at the familiar window. Ebro remains part of their working view. Elena has already spoken with Mara; there is no cutaway aboard Foundation.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: Mara called from Foundation. She's glad Gantry's people survived.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: And the delivery?

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: Still late. The penalty stands.

panels.action: Jonah listens while Elena lays out the consequence without passing blame down to the crew. This is lost margin and rescheduling, not Clearwell's destruction.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: Can we carry it?

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: It'll hurt. We can carry it. I told you to bring them home.

panels.action: Jonah puts the borrowed mug back within Elena's reach. Through the window: Baikal's ordinary work continuing. End on the object and the people, not an ominous pirate silhouette or an invitation to cheer an unpaid bill.

dialogue.speaker: Jonah
dialogue.text: At least this one's back on budget.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.text: One problem solved.
